issue.title: [build]: unable to start docker when the builder server is ubuntu 22.04

failure.body:
#### Description

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:

1. make configure PLATFORM=centec-arm64 PLATFORM_ARCH=arm64
2. make target/sonic-centec-arm64.bin

during the final image build, docker failed to start, build failed. the reason build failed because docker cannot be started.
the reason the docker cannot be started is because /sys/fs/cgroup is not mounted properly for docker service to start.

```
+ [[ arm64 == armhf ]]
+ sudo mkdir ./fsroot-centec-arm64/target
+ sudo mount --bind target ./fsroot-centec-arm64/target
+ sudo LANG=C DOCKER_HOST= chroot ./fsroot-centec-arm64 docker info
Client:
 Context:    default
 Debug Mode: false
 Plugins:
  app: Docker App (Docker Inc., v0.9.1-beta3)
  buildx: Docker Buildx (Docker Inc., v0.8.1-docker)

Server:
ERROR: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running?
errors pretty printing info
```

#### Describe the results you received:

#### Describe the results you expected:

do not see such issue on ubuntu 20.04

resolution.title: [Build] mount cgroup2 in chroot to fix build on ubuntu 22.04
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it

Ubuntu 22.04 uses cgroup2 by default, but docker.sh doesn't  mount it.
As a result we get an error when trying to run `docker info` in chroot env:

ERROR: Cannot connect to the Docker daemon at unix:///var/run/docker.sock. Is the docker daemon running?

#### How I did it

mount cgroup2 in chroot if all enabled kernel cgroup controllers are currently not in use by cgroup1

#### How to verify it

With this fix the build finished successfully on ubuntu 22.04
